resources.string:
AdbClipboard - Secure Clipboard Sync for Developers 
 
This app enables clipboard synchronization between your Android device and PC using ADB - no external servers required. 
 
🔄 Automatic sync: PC → Android (via Python script) 
📱 Manual sync: Android → PC (tap floating window) 
 
📋 Full setup guide & downloads: 
github.com/PRosenb/AdbClipboard 
 
⚡ Quick start: 
1. Visit the GitHub repository above 
2. Download and run the Python script 
3. Enable "Display over other apps" permission 
4. Start syncing! 
 
💡 TIP: No need to keep this screen open. The app runs in the background and shows a floating window. 
 
Perfect for developers in restricted environments where external clipboard services are blocked. 
 
🔧 Buttons explained: 
• "Enable overlay permission" - Appears if permission not yet granted. Tap to open Android settings, then find AdbClipboard in the list and toggle the permission on. 
• "Hide info" - Closes this screen but keeps the floating window active 
• "Exit app" - Completely closes AdbClipboard including the floating window 
• "Hide bubble"/"Show bubble" - Toggles the floating window on and off 
 
💡 TIP: Tap the bubble to sync, drag it to move (it snaps to the edge),

fling it off-screen to dismiss, or double-tap it to hide. 
🔲 TIP: For quicker access, add the "Sync clipboard" Quick Settings tile from the Quick Settings edit screen.
Tap to show the floating bubble
